consequence.statement: Layer 7 policies for Cassandra and Memcached still work for now but are deprecated, and their getting started guides are gone; the evidence gives no removal release.
consequence.remediation: Find any network policies that use Cassandra or Memcached L7 rules and plan to move off them.

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0, Layer 7 policy support for Cassandra and Memcached is deprecated, and the getting started guides for both have been removed.

decision.reason: [ev-23473218087f] says only that Layer 7 policy support for Cassandra and Memcached has been "deprecated" and that their getting started guides were removed. It does not say these policies are rejected, ignored or removed in 1.17. That makes this a deprecation (review), not mandatory work. The proposed statement also correctly notes that no removal release is given; other entries in the same section name v1.18 when a release is known, for example [ev-21e07cf98d97].
